situations.title: 응급 세팅 신속 준비
situations.tagline: This is an emergency add-on — let's get the room turned over and ready fast.
keyPhrases: Let's get the room set up as fast as we can.
I'm opening the basic emergency setup now.
Tell me what you need first and I'll grab it.

situations.title: 응급 기구 세트 개방
situations.tagline: Open the emergency laparotomy set — we're going in right away.
keyPhrases: Opening the emergency lap set now.
Major instruments are up and counted.
What else do you want opened for backup?

situations.title: 대량 흡인 준비
situations.tagline: Let's have two suction setups ready — we could hit a lot of blood.
keyPhrases: I've got two suctions on and ready.
Extra canisters and tubing are standing by.
Say the word and I'll swap them out fast.

situations.title: 혈액 확보 확인
situations.tagline: How many units do we have in the room and how fast can we get more?
situations.brief: 혈액 준비 상태를 확인해 팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: We have units in the cooler right here.
Blood bank can send more within minutes.
I'll keep a line open with the blood bank.

situations.title: 신속 초기 계수
situations.tagline: Let's do a quick baseline count before we start — sponges and instruments.
situations.brief: 응급 상황에서도 신속한 초기 계수를 개시하세요.
keyPhrases: Quick baseline count before we open.
Sponges and sharps are counted and recorded.
We'll reconcile everything at closing.

situations.title: 긴급 팀 소집
situations.tagline: I'm calling in the full team — we need more hands in here now.
keyPhrases: I'm paging additional staff to the room.
We need a second scrub and another circulator.
Anesthesia backup is on the way.

situations.title: 복강 대량 출혈
situations.tagline: There's a belly full of blood — I need suction and lap pads fast.
situations.brief: 복강 내 대량 출혈에 신속히 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The abdomen is full of blood — suctioning now.
Handing you lap pads to pack the quadrants.
I'll call for more blood to the room.
goals: 복강 대량 출혈에 흡인과 packing으로 대응한다

situations.title: 응급 제왕 신생아 준비
situations.tagline: Baby's coming out fast — is the warmer on and the neonatal team here?
keyPhrases: The infant warmer is on and ready.
Neonatal resuscitation supplies are set up.
Is the NICU team in the room yet?

situations.title: 제왕 산모 출혈 감시
situations.tagline: Keep an eye on her bleeding after delivery — I'm watching for uterine atony.
keyPhrases: I'm watching closely for postpartum hemorrhage.
Uterotonics are drawn up and ready if we need them.
Her tone is soft — do you want oxytocin now?

situations.title: 신속 마취 유도 협조
situations.tagline: We're doing a rapid sequence induction — I need cricoid pressure ready.
keyPhrases: Suction is on and cricoid pressure is ready.
Tell me when to apply and when to release.
Tube and blade are set on your right.

situations.title: 시간 압박 무균 유지
situations.tagline: I know we're rushing, but let's keep the field sterile — I'll help you gown quickly.
keyPhrases: Even in a rush, we protect the sterile field.
Let me gown and glove you quickly.
Watch your hands — I'll guide you in.

situations.title: 다발성 외상 우선순위
situations.tagline: He's got multiple injuries — help me figure out what we address first.
situations.brief: 다발성 외상의 처치 우선순위 조율에 협조하세요.
keyPhrases: The biggest bleeding source comes first.
I'll have supplies staged for both injuries.
Tell me your priority and I'll set up for it.

situations.title: 신속 수혈 조율
situations.tagline: We're transfusing fast — help me keep the units and timing straight.
situations.brief: 신속 수혈 상황에서 혈액 투여를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm tracking every unit as it goes in.
Next cooler is ready when this one's done.
I'll call out totals as we transfuse.
goals: 신속 수혈 시 혈액 투여를 조율한다

situations.title: 태아 곤란 신속 분만
situations.tagline: The baby's heart rate is dropping — we need to deliver right now.
situations.brief: 태아 곤란 상황에서 신속 분만에 협조하세요.
keyPhrases: Fetal heart rate is dropping — I'm ready to go.
Warmer and neonatal team are standing by.
Everything you need to deliver is right here.

situations.title: 응급 검체·계수 관리
situations.tagline: In all this rush, let's still keep the specimens and counts organized.
situations.brief: 응급 상황에서 검체와 계수를 정확히 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm labeling each specimen as it comes off.
Running count is documented despite the pace.
We'll do a full reconciliation before closing.

situations.title: 개복 중 심정지
situations.tagline: We've lost the pulse — start compressions and get the crash cart in here.
situations.brief: 개복 중 심정지에 즉시 소생 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: No pulse — I'm starting compressions now.
Crash cart is here and epinephrine is drawn.
I'll run the code timing and call it out.

situations.title: 산모 대량 출혈 위기
situations.tagline: She's hemorrhaging badly after delivery — activate the OB massive transfusion protocol.
situations.brief: 산모 대량 출혈 위기에 신속히 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Activating the OB massive transfusion protocol.
Uterotonics are in and I'm calling for more blood.
I'll track EBL and units as we go.

situations.title: 신생아 소생 지원
situations.tagline: The baby isn't breathing — get him to the warmer and start resuscitation.
keyPhrases: Baby's on the warmer — starting resuscitation.
Bag-mask ready and suction is set.
Is the neonatal team taking over now?

situations.title: 파종성 응고장애
situations.tagline: She's bleeding from everywhere — this looks like DIC setting in.
keyPhrases: She's oozing everywhere — this is DIC.
I need FFP, platelets, and cryo now.
Blood bank is preparing the products.

situations.title: 손상통제 수술 전환
situations.tagline: We can't fix everything now — let's pack, close temporarily, and go damage control.
keyPhrases: Let's pack and do a temporary closure.
We'll resuscitate in ICU and come back.
I have the temp closure supplies ready.

situations.title: 다중 위기 동시 대응
situations.tagline: We've got bleeding, an unstable airway, and a crashing pressure all at once — let's divide and conquer.
situations.brief: 여러 위기가 동시에 발생한 상황을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: You take the airway, I'll manage the transfusion.
Let's assign a role to each pair of hands.
I'll keep the whole team updated as it changes.
